title: tragacantha stipulata
intro: Tragacantha stipulata, commonly known as Astragalus, is a plant species in the legume family, Fabaceae. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its immune-boosting and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha stipulata include its ability to reduce stress and fatigue, as well as its potential to alleviate symptoms of respiratory and cardiovascular diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
